# Release notes

The newest release is first. In Odoo the version number starts with the Odoo version, so release 1.1.0 for Odoo 20.0 shows as `20.0.1.1.0`.

## 1.0.1

*2026-11-04, Odoo 17.0 - 20.0*

- Two editions on the Apps Store: Community ($99) and Enterprise ($149, adds labels in work order Print Labels steps; $50 for owners of the Community edition).
- App descriptions updated.

## 1.0.0

*2026-11-04, Odoo 17.0 - 20.0*

- First release: drag-and-drop label designer inside Odoo with text, fields, barcodes (Code 128, EAN-13, EAN-8, UPC-A, Code 39), QR codes, Data Matrix, boxes, lines, circles, images, line tables and nested labels (another design for each line of a list); text, barcodes and images can be rotated.
- Formats in fields such as `{lst_price|money}`, `{name|upper}`, `{date|date:%d.%m.%Y}` and `{partner_id|address}`; Python formulas, off until an administrator switches them on.
- ZPL II output for 203, 300 and 600 dpi printers, in UTF-8, Windows-1252 or code page 850, and PDF output from the same design.
- Print actions in the Print menu of any model, a Label Designer format in Odoo's Print Labels window for products and for lots and serial numbers of transfers, a default design per window, and designs in the Print Labels steps of work orders (Odoo Enterprise, with the included Work Orders module).
- Label previews in the list of designs, label size in millimetres or inches, Duplicate button.
- Eight example designs: product labels 50 x 25 mm and 100 x 50 mm, lot, package, package contents with nested lines, location and a 100 x 150 mm shipping label.
